subrules.name: 701.79b
subrules.rule: As a permanent acclimates, its controller may reveal a Weather card they own from outside the game or in their graveyard and put it into their hand. If they don't, they put a +1/+1 counter on that permanent.

subrules.name: 701.79c
subrules.rule: If an effect instructs a player to acclimate, they may reveal a Weather card they own from outside the game or in their graveyard and put it into their hand. If they don't, they put a +1/+1 counter on a creature they control.

mechanics.original_reminder: You may put a Weather card from your graveyard or outside the game into your hand, or put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
mechanics.executable_reminder: You may choose a Weather card you own from your graveyard or from outside the game. If you do, reveal it and put it into your hand. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: Rule 701.79c requires an optional owned Weather choice across graveyard and outside game, reveal and hand movement; declining puts a counter on a chosen own creature, without targeting. Native union-zone selection remains unverified.
